decision: Do not port the old RemainingFiles phase class. Preserve surviving behavior as active template inventory, preference metadata, and deletion recipes.
already_active: inventory template files when templates.entries is omitted
rename gem.gemspec to an existing destination gemspec
prefer .no-osc.example when Open Collective is disabled
apply configured file and pattern strategies
merge README, Ruby-family, YAML, TOML, Markdown, and text template files through active recipes

report_contract.copy_only_when_missing: existing destination produces a template preference with strategy=keep_destination and policy=copy_only_when_missing
report_contract.legacy_destination_cleanup: legacy path produces a supplied_legacy_destination_file_deletion recipe when canonical content is active

verification.command: mise exec -C ruby -- bundle exec rspec gems/kettle-jem/spec/thin_slice_spec.rb
